inputs.label: Teraburst arcade ROM set (MAME terabrst)
inputs.help: Your own complete terabrst.zip (Teraburst, July 17, 1998, US UEL). Leave it zipped. A .7z renamed to .zip does not work. No CHD or BIOS is needed.

steps.why: The app reads the ROM set from Download. The guide has the user allow file access on the first start.

steps.text: Open Teraburst VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for file access, allow it. Keep both controllers awake. The setup screen checks the ROM set, then starts VR. Press A to add credits and start.

notes: The guide says "allow the requested file access" without naming the permission; All files access is assumed. Releases also carry teraburst-vr-pcvr.zip and teraburst-vr-source.zip, which the asset pattern does not match.
